ledger_credit AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR) AS order_id,

      CASE
    WHEN MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(
                COALESCE(
                    selected_payment_mode,
                    group_order_payment_mode,
                    max_payment_channel,
                    group_order_payment_channel,
                    payment_gateway,
                    pg_method,
                    method_detail
                )
            ) LIKE '%cash%'
            OR LOWER(
                COALESCE(
                    selected_payment_mode,
                    group_order_payment_mode,
                    max_payment_channel,
                    group_order_payment_channel,
                    payment_gateway,
                    pg_method,
                    method_detail
                )
            ) LIKE '%manual%'
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) = 1
    THEN 'cash'

    WHEN MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(
                COALESCE(
                    selected_payment_mode,
                    group_order_payment_mode,
                    max_payment_channel,
                    group_order_payment_channel,
                    payment_gateway,
                    pg_method,
                    method_detail
                )
            ) LIKE '%pos%'
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) = 1
    THEN 'pos'

    ELSE 'online'
END AS order_payment_type

    FROM dwh_finance.consolidated_ledger_v2
    WHERE revenue_type = 'Credit'
      AND order_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR)
)

SELECT
    b.fy,
    b.business_line,
    COALESCE(l.order_payment_type, 'online') AS order_payment_type,
    SUM(b.earned) AS earned
FROM b2c_union b
LEFT JOIN ledger_credit l
    ON CAST(b.order_id AS VARCHAR) = l.order_id
GROUP BY
    b.fy,
    b.business_line,
    COALESCE(l.order_payment_type, 'online')
ORDER BY
    b.fy,
    b.business_line,
    order_payment_type
